subject: Life Skills

source.topic: Personal and Social Well-being: Healthy habits
source.subtopic: Sleep, eating healthy food, washing hands; keeping hair, teeth and nails clean; some good habits

show.line: Healthy habits: sleep well, eat healthy food, wash hands, brush teeth and play!

rounds.prompt: Healthy habit or not? Sort them.
When should you go to sleep on a school night?
How do we keep nails clean?
What do we do after the toilet?

rounds.story: Sibu watches TV all afternoon. His sister plays soccer outside. Who has the healthier habit?

hints: A habit is something we do every day.
Healthy habits help our bodies grow strong.

beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I will watch TV until midnight!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! We need sleep to grow.

parent_line: Knows healthy habits like sleep, exercise, washing and brushing teeth.
